name: iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::?:role/deployment/* ('?' account wildcard) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 4 BLOCKER regression: the '?' spelling of the account-wildcard fail-open. AWS honors BOTH ARN wildcards; a leading '?' account segment is just as account-crossing as '*' (it matches any single-character account and, combined with the account glob, reaches beyond one pinned account). startsWithArnWildcard() already tests '*' OR '?', so the account-crossing broadness must hold for the '?' spelling too or the same fail-open reopens under a new spelling (threat-model T8). WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) must fire.
